subject: English
question_text: Which of the following best narrates the definition of character?

options.i: Character to a man is as important as the crown
options.ii: A man without character is very much near to a beast
options.iii: Character is a sum total of all good qualities of human life
options.iv: A man of character is admired and loved everywhere

answer_pointer: Character is a sum total of all good qualities of human life
guide_solution: character is a sum total of all good qualities of human life
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 98 — Nasirabad Govt. Boys' High School, Chittagong
